title: Every calendar opens on the current month, not a stale or UTC one

source.ref: Daniel, 2026-10-28: make sure the calendar always starts on the current month

detail:
Every calendar mount now picks its opening month through one rule, openingMonth: a month named in the link (?y=&m=) wins, otherwise the current month in the Space's own zone, never the month of its first or most events. The grid also corrects an unpinned render in the browser; before, it only did so inside the few hours around a UTC month boundary, so a render carrying an earlier month (a tab or cached page from before) stayed there.

Closed by the PR that adds openingMonth.

verify.note: Fails on main (no openingMonth, UTC-only grid correction); passes here.
